## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the code of conduct.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the existing project license and retained third-party attribution.
- [ ] Stable URLs, semantic IDs, and storage keys are preserved, or a separately agreed migration is tested.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, or I explained why it could not run.
- [ ] `npm run check:docs` passes, or I explained why it could not run.
- [ ] Available languages and planned content are labeled honestly.
- [ ] No secrets, learner data, textbook scans, or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance and its verification are disclosed, if applicable.
